title: 2026 UK ETS maritime improvement-report QA controls

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for maritime: how to comply

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS

facts.source_fact: A METS improvement-report task is generated where the verifier identifies non-conformities in the annual emissions report.
facts.expected_handling: Create remediation workflow only from evidenced verifier findings.

facts.source_fact: A METS improvement-report task can also arise where the verifier recommends improvements to monitoring and reporting.
facts.expected_handling: Track recommendations separately from formal non-conformities.

facts.source_fact: A non-conformity means the annual emissions report does not follow the emissions monitoring plan or comply with the Order.
facts.expected_handling: Classify findings against plan and legal requirements.

facts.source_fact: Recommended improvements may concern risk assessment, data-flow activities, control activities, related procedures, and the way emissions are monitored and reported.
facts.expected_handling: Map each recommendation to a defined control area.

facts.source_fact: The improvement report must describe how and when the operator will address non-conformities and implement recommended improvements.
facts.expected_handling: Require action plus timing for each open item.

facts.source_fact: The improvement report is due by 30 June in the year the related annual emissions report was submitted, unless the Environment Agency sets another date.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the regulator-set alternative date only where evidenced.

facts.source_fact: If the operator says a recommendation would not improve the monitoring methodology, it must justify that position.
facts.expected_handling: Require evidence-backed justification rather than silent rejection.

facts.source_fact: If the operator says improvement costs would be unreasonable, it must provide evidence.
facts.expected_handling: Require cost evidence before accepting an unreasonable-cost assertion.

facts.source_fact: Verifier comments may require the operator to apply in METS to vary its emissions monitoring plan.
facts.expected_handling: Link remediation to plan variation where necessary.

facts.source_fact: An improvement report is not required if by 30 June all identified non-conformities and recommendations have already been addressed and any related monitoring-plan variations have been applied for.
facts.expected_handling: Close the task only when both remediation and required variation evidence exist.

guard_patterns.handling: Map non-conformity to plan or Order requirement.
Use 30 June unless evidenced alternative date exists.
Require rationale where recommendation is rejected as non-beneficial.
Link required plan changes to METS variation.
Close only after fixes and required variations are evidenced.
Improvement findings do not by themselves create a new measured emissions value.
Flag missing findings, dates, evidence or variation links.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
